definitions.verified: strict default contract: complete_generic result accepted by the independent `symgcad verify` in a fresh process (cold run) or in the data.json audit (history)
definitions.solve_s: fresh-process wall seconds of `symgcad solve` (includes process start, in-run ordering search, preprocessing and export of result.json), one pinned CPU, cold: fresh run directory and TMPDIR, no persistent checkpoints (a fresh checkpoint_dir only for MCTS searches); perf_counter around the wrapper chain in a per-group worker process pinned to that CPU; median over the repeats (solve_s_runs), each of which must verify the same cell count
definitions.verify_s: fresh-process wall seconds of `symgcad verify`, measured the same way (median over the repeats)
definitions.native_s: sum over sign cases of the native GCAD process wall time (Python start, SymPy parsing, native ordering, projection, lifting), GNU time elapsed per case (10 ms resolution); each case capped at 300 s
definitions.ratio: symGCAD solve_s / native_s; only where both complete
definitions.order: variable order of the exported result (projection eliminates from the end); H = homogeneous anchor fixed to 1 before solving
definitions.opt_in: opt-in projective contract: cell boundaries may reach +infinity inside a cell (solver.projective_sections); never counted in the strict completion count

reruns.purpose: rerun of the 2 sign cases that failed with std::bad_alloc under the 8192 MiB RLIMIT_AS cap (finiteA_6_159 and finiteAx12_6_159 symbolic, signs=+); same protocol (300 s, one pinned CPU), only the address-space cap raised to 24576 MiB; failed attempts kept in <case>/attempts/

protocol.sign_expansion: src/benchmark.rs run_campaign: (split) >/< 0 per mask, split cleared
protocol.ordering: problem's own policy: native greedy mods/t1/sotd or given order
